verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented bulk or account-level data export, no takeout or archive of generations, prompts and assets, and nothing on account deletion or offboarding. The 16-bit EXR/ACES export is a per-render output format for compositing workflows. It is related but different, so it earns no credit toward exporting all of a user's data and leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
